description: This file defines an interface 'UriFactoryInterface' which declares a method for creating URI objects within the PSR HTTP Message package. It specifies a single method 'createUri' that takes a string and returns a UriInterface instance, potentially throwing an InvalidArgumentException.

classes.name: UriFactoryInterface
classes.description: An interface for factories that create URI instances

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates a new URI object from a string, potentially throwing an InvalidArgumentException if the URI cannot be parsed
